supporting_observations.claim: At 13:40:29 UTC, a successful proxy GET for https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nwd-it/tools/main/u.ps1 was recorded for NWD\ivy.chen from WS-ICHEN-01. The request used client source port 64473 and is associated with the raw.githubusercontent.com tunnel recorded at the same time.
The script retrieval is close in time to the reported PowerShell window, but the supplied records do not establish that the downloaded script was executed or that it caused the reported window.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied evidence records the script URL and HTTP status, but not the response body or the retrieved file's contents or hash (T033-00091).
No PowerShell process-creation record or command line is present in the supplied records around the retrieval time; the available evidence therefore cannot confirm execution.
claims_not_established: Whether u.ps1 was executed, and whether it was responsible for the reported PowerShell window (the retrieval is recorded in T033-00091).
Whether the script's contents and the nwd-it/tools repository were authorized or benign.
What command line, parent process, or user action—if any—opened PowerShell.
additional_evidence_needed: Endpoint process-creation, PowerShell operational, and script-block logs for WS-ICHEN-01 around 13:40 UTC.
The downloaded u.ps1 file or a recoverable copy, including its hash and contents.
Repository ownership, commit history, and confirmation from IT whether this download was an authorized action.
Ivy Chen's confirmation of what she saw and whether she or an application initiated the download.
unrelated_findings: DropboxUpdate.exe ran as SYSTEM on WS-ICHEN-01 at 14:12 and exited at 14:14. Dropbox is not among the services listed as approved; track separately, and do not use this to determine the alerted activity (T033-00210, T033-00211, T033-00274, T033-00275).
